column1: # dynmul x bypass sweep. --dynmul=D extends a probe's flip budget to D*flips
# whenever the falsified-clause count improves; after a restart the budget is
# seeded at 1000 flips (static --cutoff ignored when dynmul>0). --bypass
# probabilistically re-extends a probe at the cutoff. Everything else default.
# 3x2 grid: D in {10,100,1000} x bypass in {0,1}. bypass default is 1.
